#include "acme/panel.h"
#include <vector>

#ifdef ACME_FAST
static int fastScale(int value) { return value * 2; }
#else
static int slowScale(int value) { return value + value; }
#endif

namespace acme {
namespace ui {

enum class Mode { Idle, Busy, Done };

using Size = int;

class Panel {
public:
    Panel();
    ~Panel();
    void draw(int depth) const;
    Size width;
    Size height;
    static int count;
};

int Panel::count = 0;

Panel::Panel() : width{0}, height{0}
{
    count += 1;
}

Panel::~Panel()
{
    count -= 1;
}

void Panel::draw(int depth) const
{
    ACME_TRACE(depth);
    render(width, height);
}

template <class T>
T clampValue(T value, T low, T high)
{
    return value < low ? low : (value > high ? high : value);
}

int broken(int a)
{
    return a +* ;
    missing(1, );
}

int afterBroken()
{
    return 2;
}

}  // namespace ui
}  // namespace acme
